notes: Human Foods Program letter for a 21 CFR Part 111 dietary-supplement CGMP inspection at the Phoenix, NY facility: hygiene/sanitation deficiencies (hand washing, plant cleanliness, cobwebs, residue build-up), inadequate equipment/utensil condition, missing product specifications, incomplete master manufacturing and batch production records, and inadequate complaint handling, plus a milk (or other major food allergen) labeling omission causing misbranding. All specific product/ingredient identities are redacted as (b)(4), so no product is named in clear. contamination_present is false: findings describe insanitary conditions and risk of contamination (e.g. an employee's bare arms contacting product, an ill employee not removed promptly) but no documented positive test result or confirmed actual contamination of distributed product.
